name: StartAgent

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can create and query the ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，可通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the channel to join. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 加入的频道，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: channel_id

fields.help_en: The list of user IDs subscribed by the agent. Currently, only one user ID is supported
fields.help_zh: 智能体订阅的用户userId列表，目前仅支持一个
fields.name: target_user_ids

fields.help_en: The user ID of the agent in the RTC channel
fields.help_zh: 智能体在rtc频道中的userId
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en:
The maximum duration threshold for user inactivity, in seconds.
When the duration of any of the following states reaches this threshold, the agent automatically stops and exits the channel:
All users in the targetUserIds list have left the channel.
The users in the targetUserIds list have not joined the channel.

Default value: 30.
Valid values: 5 to 180
fields.help_zh:
定义用户无活动状态的最大持续时间阈值（单位：秒）
当检测到以下任一状态持续时间达到该阈值时，智能体将自动停止并退出频道：
targetUserIds列表中的所有用户已全部离开频道
targetUserIds列表未加入频道

默认值：30
取值范围：[5, 180]
fields.name: user_inactivity_timeout

parameters.help_en: The configuration for the agent to join a Real-Time Communication (RTC) channel
parameters.help_zh: 智能体加入rtc频道的配置
parameters.name: rtc_config

fields.help_en:
If this parameter is not specified, the model automatically identifies the language.
Currently supported language codes:
zh: Chinese, including Mandarin and dialects such as Shanghainese, Wu, Minnan, Northeastern, Gansu, Guizhou, Henan, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Ningxia, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Shandong, Sichuan, Tianjin, Yunnan, and Cantonese.
en: English.
ja: Japanese.
yue: Cantonese.
ko: Korean
fields.help_zh:
不设置，模型会自动识别语种。
目前支持的语言代码：
zh: 中文（支持方言：上海话、吴语、闽南语、东北话、甘肃话、贵州话、河南话、湖北话、湖南话、江西话、宁夏话、山西话、陕西话、山东话、四川话、天津话、云南话、粤语）
en: 英文
ja: 日语
yue: 粤语
ko: 韩语
fields.name: language_hints

fields.help_en: The voice segmentation detection threshold. Default value: 800. Unit: milliseconds. Recommended range: 200 to 6000
fields.help_zh: 语音断句检测阈值，默认800ms，参考范围[200,6000]
fields.name: max_sentence_silence

fields.help_en: Specifies whether semantic or voice segmentation is enabled
fields.help_zh: 语义断句/语音断句
fields.name: semantic_punctuation_enabled

fields.help_en: No configuration is required
fields.help_zh: 无需设置
fields.name: source_language

fields.help_en:
The minimum duration of continuous human voice signals required to avoid false interruptions, in milliseconds.
Valid values: 0 to 3000.
Default value: 300
fields.help_zh:
人声持续阈值 (ms)，取值范围为[0,3000]。持续检测到人声信号的最小时间长度，避免误打断。
默认300ms
fields.name: interrupt_speech_duration

fields.help_en: The Voice Activity Detection (VAD) configuration
fields.help_zh: vad配置
fields.name: vad_config

fields.help_en: The ID of the supported hot word
fields.help_zh: 支持的热词ID
fields.name: vocabulary_id

fields.help_en: The Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) configuration
fields.help_zh: ASR配置
fields.name: asr_config

fields.help_en:
The timeout period for silence reminders, in seconds.
This reminder can be triggered multiple times. If the agent remains silent after a silence reminder timeout, the reminder is triggered again upon the next timeout.
Valid values: 5 to 600.
Default value: 0. A value of 0 indicates that no reminder is sent
fields.help_zh:
静默提醒的超时时间（单位：秒）。
可能多次触发，若智能体静默提醒超时后依然静默，则再超时还会继续触发
取值范围：[5, 600]，默认值0，0表示不提醒
fields.name: alert_timeout

fields.help_en: The content of the silence prompt message
fields.help_zh: 静默提示消息的内容
fields.name: content

fields.help_en: The switch
fields.help_zh: 开关
fields.name: enable

fields.help_en:
The script strategy for silence reminders. Valid values:
1: Broadcast the prompt message specified by Content to the user by voice.
2: Send the prompt message specified by Content and the conversation history to the LLM, and broadcast the generated reply by voice.
Default value: 1
fields.help_zh:
静默提醒的话术策略。
1 - 向用户语音播报content指定的提示消息
2 - 把content指定的提示消息和历史对话发送给LLM，并播报模型生成的回复
默认值：1
fields.name: strategy

fields.help_en:
The silence timeout period for triggering the agent silence timeout webhook, in seconds.
This webhook can be triggered multiple times. If the agent remains silent after a webhook silence timeout, the webhook is triggered again upon the next timeout.
Valid values: 10 to 600.
Default value: 0. A value of 0 indicates that the webhook is not triggered
fields.help_zh:
触发智能体静默超时webhook的静默超时时间（单位：秒）。可能多次触发，若智能体webhook静默超时后依然静默，则再超时还会继续触发
取值范围：[10, 600]，默认值0，0表示不触发
fields.name: webhook_trigger_timeout

fields.help_en: The configuration for agent behavior during silence timeout. When a user joins the channel but does not interact effectively with the agent (the user does not speak), the agent is in a silent state. You can configure the agent to broadcast a voice messaging reminder or send a webhook notification during this silent state
fields.help_zh: 当用户加入频道后，但未与智能体进行有效交互（用户未发言），此时智能体处于静默状态，可以配置智能体在静默状态下的行为：播报静默语音消息提醒或webhook通知
fields.name: agent_silence_config

fields.help_en:
The ambient sound ID. Built-in and download modes are planned. Currently, only the built-in mode is supported.
If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, ambient sound is disabled.
Built-in mode: The agent provides the following default ambient sounds: white_noise (white noise) and office (office environment).
Download mode: You can specify a custom soundId in the console (which must be different from built-in IDs) and provide a URL. The agent will download and bind the sound internally
fields.help_zh:
环境音计划支持内置与下载（后续），当前先实现内置模式
当不传字段或者字段为空时，表示不开启环境音
内置模式：agent提供以下默认环境音：white_noise（白噪声）office（办公室）
下载模式：支持客户在控制台填写soundId（不可与内置id相同），并填写url，agent内部会进行下载并绑定
fields.name: sound_id

fields.help_en:
The volume of the ambient sound.
Default value: 50 (original volume).
Valid values: 0 to 100
fields.help_zh: 环境音音量，默认50（原声）。范围【0 - 100】
fields.name: volume

fields.help_en: The ambient sound settings
fields.help_zh: 环境音设置
fields.name: ambient_sound_config

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable backchannel responses after the user finishes speaking. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 用户说完话后，是否开启承接词。默认值是false
fields.name: user_turn_end

fields.help_en: The Version
fields.help_zh: The Version
fields.name: version

fields.help_en: The backchannel settings
fields.help_zh: 承接词设置
fields.name: back_channel_config

fields.help_en:
The chat mode. Valid values:
1: natural conversation mode. This is the default value.
2: walkie-talkie mode
fields.help_zh: 1-自然对话模式 (默认值); 2-对讲机模式
fields.name: chat_mode

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable visual understanding. If enabled, the large language model (LLM) must support multimodal data
fields.help_zh: 是否开启视觉理解如果开启，LLM模型必须支持多模态数据
fields.name: enable_video_understanding

fields.help_en: The greeting message
fields.help_zh: 问候语
fields.name: greeting

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable semantic interruption. Default value: true
fields.help_zh: 是否开启语义打断。默认值是true
fields.name: semantics_interrupt

fields.help_en: The interrupt settings
fields.help_zh: 打断设置
fields.name: interrupt_config

fields.help_en:
The interrupt mode. Valid values:
1: voice interruption supported. This is the default value.
2: voice interruption disabled
fields.help_zh: 1-支持语音打断 (默认值)，2-禁用语音打断
fields.name: interrupt_mode

fields.help_en: The API key of the service provider
fields.help_zh: 服务商apikey
fields.name: api_key

fields.help_en: The agent application ID. You must specify either Model or AppId. If both are specified, AppId takes precedence
fields.help_zh:
智能体应用ID
model，appId二选一即可。如果model，appId都填写了，优先使用appId
fields.name: app_id

fields.help_en: The custom parameters
fields.help_zh: 自定义参数
fields.name: biz_params

fields.help_en:
The number of historical conversation turns provided to the LLM.
Default value: 3
fields.help_zh:
给大模型提供多少历史对话轮次。
默认值3
fields.name: history_depth

fields.help_en:
The maximum number of tokens for the output text.
Default value: 8192.
The maximum value for DeepSeek and Qwen models is 8192
fields.help_zh:
输出文本的最大限制，默认值8192
deepseek qwen模型最大值为8192
fields.name: max_token

fields.help_en:
The model name.
Supported models under the aliyun provider:
["qwen-plus", "deepseek-r1", "qwen-omni-turbo"]
fields.help_zh:
模型名称
aliyun服务商下支持模型:
["qwen-plus", "deepseek-r1", "qwen-omni-turbo"]
fields.name: model

fields.help_en: The custom user parameters in key-value pairs. This parameter is deprecated. Use the BizParams parameter instead
fields.help_zh: 用户自定义参数，键值对。即将弃用，请使用bizParams字段
fields.name: params

fields.help_en: The prompt used to instruct the model on the role or behavior to adopt
fields.help_zh: 用于告知模型要扮演的角色或行为
fields.name: prompt

fields.help_en:
The sampling temperature used to control the randomness and creativity of the generated text. A higher value indicates higher randomness.
Default value: 0.7.
Valid values: 0 to 2, excluding 2.
Note: This parameter does not take effect for deepseek-r1
fields.help_zh:
采样温度，用于控制生成文本的随机性和创造性，值越大随机性越高。
默认值0.7
取值范围[0,2)
deepseek-r1设置该参数不生效
fields.name: temperature

fields.help_en: The ToolExecutionConfig
fields.help_zh: The ToolExecutionConfig
fields.name: tool_execution_config

fields.help_en: The Tools
fields.help_zh: The Tools
fields.name: tools

fields.help_en:
The sampling range used to control the diversity of output tokens. The model samples from tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds this value to ensure the sampling range is not too broad. A higher value indicates a richer variety of output tokens.
Valid values: 0 to 1, excluding 0.
Default value: 0.8
fields.help_zh:
采样的选择范围，控制输出 token 的多样性。模型将从概率分布中累计概率超过该取值的标记中进行采样，以确保采样的选择范围不会过宽，值越大输出的 token 类型越丰富。
取值范围(0,1]，默认值0.8
fields.name: topp

fields.help_en: The endpoint URL for integrating a third-party LLM
fields.help_zh: 接入第三方的大模型时，此字段表示大模型的接入url
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The name of the service provider when a cloud service provider is integrated. Examples: aliyun for Model Studio, thirdparty
fields.help_zh: 接入云服务提供商时，此字段表示服务商的名称。示例：aliyun[百炼]、thirdparty

fields.name: llm_config

fields.help_zh: 服务商apikey
fields.name: api_key

fields.help_zh: 过滤设定符号范围内的字符不被转成语音
fields.name: filter_brackets

fields.help_zh: 模型名称【cosyvoice-v1】
fields.name: model

The pitch.
Valid values: 0.5 to 2.0.
Default value: 1.0

The speech rate.

Default value: 1.0

可选音色：

fields.help_en:
After visual understanding is enabled, you can specify the video stream that the agent prioritizes for understanding. The agent can understand only one video stream when both the camera stream and the screen sharing stream are pushed simultaneously.

The agent prioritizes the camera stream.
The agent prioritizes the screen sharing stream.

By default, the camera stream is prioritized
fields.help_zh:
开启视觉理解后，可以设置智能体优先理解的视频流。智能体只能理解一路视频流，当Camera流和屏幕共享流同时推流。

智能体优先理解Camera流；
智能体优先理解屏幕共享流；

默认优先理解Camera流
